key_insight: MobileGym is a browser-hosted, forkable mobile GUI simulator that captures the full environment as structured JSON to enable deterministic, verifiable task outcomes and massively parallel, low-cost RL rollouts.
problem_solved: Bridges the gap between realistic everyday mobile app interaction and reproducible RL research by removing dependence on proprietary backends and providing verifiable outcome signals and scalable parallelism.
method: Host lightweight mobile app simulations in the browser and expose the entire environment state as structured JSON snapshots.
Use deterministic, state-based judges over JSON to produce verifiable outcome signals and enable exact comparison of runs.
Support forking, configuring, and parallelizing JSON states to run many low-cost, synchronous rollouts for scalable online RL.
impact: Enables reproducible benchmarking and fast iteration for mobile GUI agents, lowering compute and setup cost for training and evaluation while providing trustworthy outcome verification for research and deployment.
visual_elements: Architecture diagram: browser-hosted simulator → JSON state store → deterministic judge + RL worker pool
Flowchart: user interaction → JSON snapshot → deterministic judge → verifiable outcome (pass/fail)
Bar/line chart: parallel rollout throughput and cost comparison vs real-device testing
State fork tree: visualization of JSON snapshot forking and parallel branch rollouts
paper_title: MobileGym: A Verifiable and Highly Parallel Simulation Platform for Mobile GUI Agent Research
paper_authors: Dingbang Wu, Rui Hao, Haiyang Wang, Shuzhe Wu, Han Xiao
